rationale.conceptual: Standard DFT method (PBE pseudopotentials) applied to small molecules and clusters; the paper's original specialized FP-LMTO is not required. The agent needs to construct adsorption geometries, run geometry optimizations, and compute adsorption energies — routine tasks in computational chemistry with well‑defined inputs.
rationale.execution: The workflow involves ~12 DFT runs (free references + multiple adsorption complexes) that can be scripted in a simple loop. There are no fragile multi‑tool handoffs, no complex data acquisition, and output artifacts are straightforward CSV files. Orchestration is uncomplicated.
